snippet.title: Torment Hexus announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Torment Hexus on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3238420/Torment_Hexus/

Technofascist cyberpunk CEOs must die! Charge spells with the match-3 grid, then cast them on your enemies in turn-based tactical roguelike combat. Climb the tower, kill the boss, and maybe make the world a better place.

Torment Hexus is a match-3 tactical combat roguelike by TMA Games, the creators of Waves of Steel.
